note: Announcements shown in the launcher (1.3.0+). Patch notes are added automatically from the GitHub releases - do not copy them here.

items.title: New launcher: live server status
items.summary: See which modes are online and how many are playing, before you hit PLAY.
items.body:
The launcher now shows the real state of every server:
- Survival, Extraction and Search & Destroy: online or offline, and how many are playing
- Your ping to the Aethon servers
- Patch notes appear here automatically with every update

Also new:
- Remember me now keeps you signed in for 30 days
- Settings > About > Send logs: if something goes wrong, one click sends us your launcher log
- The launcher updates itself in the background and shows the progress at the top

items.title: Aethon accounts are live
items.summary: Create a username + password in the launcher. One account for every mode.
items.body:
Every server now requires an Aethon account.

1. On the login screen, click Create Account
2. Pick a username (3-16 letters, numbers or _) and a password (8+ characters)
3. Sign in and press PLAY

The name over your head and in chat is your account name. One account works in Survival, Extraction and Search & Destroy.

items.title: Controls Guide
items.summary: Every key for Survival, Extraction and Search & Destroy.
items.body:
Default keys (Settings > Controls can rebind movement, combat and hotbar keys).

MOVEMENT
W A S D - move | Mouse - look | Space - jump
Shift (hold) - sprint | C (hold) - crouch | Q / E (hold) - lean left / right

COMBAT
Left mouse - fire (hold for automatic weapons) | Right mouse (hold) - aim
Shift while aiming - hold breath (steadier scope, ~4 s)
R - reload | 1-6 or mouse wheel - hotbar | T - weapon light (if attached)
L - inspect weapon | Page Up / Page Down - sight zeroing

ITEMS
Tab - inventory (drag items; right-click for options; Shift-drag splits a stack)
7 / 8 / 9 - quick bandage / medkit / water | F5 - quick save

INTERACT
F - interact: loot, open doors and boxes, pick up, talk to traders, open benches and furnaces
Crouch + F at a player or trader - pickpocket | X at your code lock - lock menu
Space on the death screen - respawn

BUILDING
B - build mode | Left mouse - place | Right mouse (hold) - piece wheel
Mouse wheel or T - change piece | R - rotate | N - snapping on/off
Left Alt (hold) - steer the piece with the mouse (wheel raises/lowers)
Looking at your piece: F upgrade to stone, G repair, U upgrade door, H (hold) demolish (first 10 minutes)

SOCIAL & MENUS
Enter - chat | Z - ping | V (hold) - emote wheel
M - map (wheel zooms, right-click sets a waypoint) | K - skills | O - clan
Esc or F10 - pause menu | F2 - report a bug

EXTRACTION
In the base: drag items between stash and loadout, double-click a container to open it, R rotates while dragging
In a raid: stand in an open extraction zone for about 7 seconds to get out

SEARCH & DESTROY
Y - buy menu (during buy time, in your spawn): 1-3 picks a category, 1-4 buys, 5 goes back
F (hold) - plant the bomb at site A/B, or defuse it (3.5 s with a kit, 7 s without)
Left mouse while dead - watch the next teammate
